title: Unsupported Targeting Dimension Details
description: Recommended details shape for UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE errors rejecting a targeting dimension that the product or seller does not support, or that was previously accepted and has been removed. Sellers MUST NOT silently drop the dimension. `error.field` SHOULD point at the targeting path (for example `packages[0].targeting_overlay.geo_countries`). Sellers echo only what the caller could already read from capabilities or Product `overlay_support`.

unsupported_dimension.description: The targeting field name that was rejected, for example `geo_countries`.

supported_dimensions.description: Targeting dimensions the caller could already read from `get_adcp_capabilities` or the product's `overlay_support`. Sellers MAY omit it; absence means consult those surfaces, not that any dimension is supported.

deprecated.description: `true` when the dimension was previously accepted and has been removed. Omitted or `false` for a dimension that was never supported.

replacement_dimension.description: Targeting dimension that replaces the rejected one. Typically set with `deprecated: true`.

product_id.description: Product the dimension was rejected for, when support is product-scoped.

package_index.description: Zero-based index of the offending package in the request's `packages` (or `new_packages`) array.
